decisions.series: One 620-card original release across Series One #1–310 and Series Two #311–620, separate wax and SuperPack configurations; pack of either series MUST NOT contain base cards from the other.
decisions.authenticity: BCP 620 individual original card numbers/subsets and 4 insert lists reconciled against independent MCB collector number/subject/team; 13 explicit base discrepancies and seven dual-front formatting discrepancies reviewed. Names and team identifiers are from printed catalogues.
decisions.variants: No invented base parallels, serials, memorabilia or autographs. Team 2000 #27a and #27b are actual Juan Guzman logo placement variants and count separately.
decisions.promos: Eight authentic Dealer Kit Samples remain separate promo-only group and must never be included in any pack pool. Total 620+12+18+81+15+8=754 physical collector entries.
decisions.scarcity: Series One Team Pinnacle 1:100 original wax, Series Two Rookie Idols 1:100 wax, Team 2000 3 per 27-card SuperPack, Slugfest Series Two Wal-Mart exclusive. Do not conflate SuperPack vs wax and do not invent odds for Slugfest.
decisions.pack: Wax 16 cards/pack, 36 packs/box; SuperPack 27 cards/pack, 16 packs/box; VCS Product uses standard 16/36 wax metadata ONLY. Requires per-series/per-format-aware collation before release.
decisions.rookies: RC annotations in card metadata only when directly identified by source; do not indiscriminately mark every subset card as a true rookie. Original #295 Manny Ramirez, #522 Jeff Kent, #555 Brian Jordan noted in sources.
decisions.images: Only genuine original card scans and original insert templates. Do not synthesize card scans, artwork, serials, promos or pack images. Leave artwork and prices pending.
decisions.release: Unreleased as draft; pack odds null because single-odds product schema cannot encode wax/SuperPack, Series One/Two, dealer-only exclusions and Walmart-only inserts. No changes to other products.

productSets.name: Base Set
productSets.notes: 620 original cards numbered 1–620, two series of 310; seven original subsets; no parallels.

productSets.name: Team Pinnacle
productSets.notes: 12 dual-front Series One wax-exclusive Chris Greco inserts; original odds 1:100.

productSets.name: Rookie Idols
productSets.notes: 18 dual-front Series Two wax-exclusive inserts; original odds 1:100.

productSets.name: Team 2000
productSets.notes: Original 80 numbered players plus actual 27a and 27b printing variants (81 distinct physical subjects). SuperPacks only, 3 per pack; 1–40 Series One and 41–80 Series Two.

productSets.name: Slugfest
productSets.notes: 15 Series Two Wal-Mart SuperPack-only inserts, never wax; no sourced numeric odds.

productSets.name: Dealer Kit Samples (Promo Only)
productSets.notes: Eight original dealer samples with base-like numbering; promotional distribution ONLY, never in either series of packs.
